user_query: I'm hosting a party and I want to create a playlist with songs from a specific album. Can you provide me with the album details, including the tracklist and artist information? Also, I would like to know the current Billboard 200 chart to add some popular songs to the playlist.

TaskList.description: Retrieve details of the specified album including tracklist and artist information.
Fetch the current Billboard 200 chart to get popular songs.
